login.title: Advanced Todo — Sign in
login.intro: Try alice, bob or carol (any non-empty password), dave to be challenged for a second factor, or erin to be offered one.

username.label: Username
username.hint: alice, bob, carol, dave or erin

choose.title: Set up two-step verification
choose.intro: Add a second step to your sign-in. Choose how you would like to confirm it is you.

skip.label: Not now
skip.spendsGrace: You can only postpone this a few more times.

error.noRenderableMethods: This app cannot set up any of the offered methods. Please update it.
error.unrenderableChallenge: This sign-in method needs a newer version of the app. Please update it, or sign in from a device that has.
error.enrolmentExpired: This set-up has expired. Cancel and sign in again to start over.
error.challengeExpired: This sign-in request has expired. Cancel and sign in again.

totp.name: Authenticator app
totp.description: Use a code from Google Authenticator, 1Password or a similar app.

enrol.intro: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then type the code it shows to confirm.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code containing your authenticator set-up link
enrol.manualEntry: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand:

challenge.codeChanged: Your authenticator now shows a new code — enter that one.

webauthn.name: Passkey
webauthn.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN — nothing to type.

enrol.intro: Create a passkey on this device. Your browser will ask you to confirm with your fingerprint, face or PIN.

challenge.intro: Use your passkey to finish signing in.

webauthn.failed: The passkey prompt was cancelled or did not complete. Try again.

adminLogin.title: Advanced Todo — Admin sign in
adminLogin.intro: Sign in as admin (password pw). A non-admin (alice, bob, carol) is rejected.

adminTwoFactor.title: Advanced Todo — Admin two-step verification
adminTwoFactor.intro: Enter the {digits}-digit code from your authenticator app.
